name: Rahul Kumar
transcript: Main saat saalon se electrician ka kaam kar raha hoon. Ghar ki wiring karta hoon, switch aur pankha lagata hoon, aur line tester se fault dhundhta hoon. MCB bhi fit karta hoon aur DB board bhi dekhta hoon.
transcript_en: I have been doing electrician work for seven years. I do house wiring, install switches and fans, and find faults using a line tester. I also fit MCBs and look after DB boards.

name: Priya Devi
transcript: I have three years of experience doing domestic wiring. I install light points, fan points, and socket outlets. I use a multimeter to check voltage and continuity. I am learning about earthing and distribution boards.
transcript_en: I have three years of experience doing domestic wiring. I install light points, fan points, and socket outlets. I use a multimeter to check voltage and continuity. I am learning about earthing and distribution boards.
